value.rationale: The result finds a canonical and previously unlocated Euclidean geometric approximation invariant for every length \(2^m-1\) binary Hamming codeword polytope. It classifies every farthest point and all unique nearest projections on explicit growing-dimension simplex faces; and it quantifies the sharp collapse from discrete covering radius one to convexification radius \(2/\sqrt{n+3}\), tending to zero. This is structural information about a motivated coding/geometric relaxation, not a generic coordinate slice or numerical table.
